title: Phantasma Prime
extract:
Phantasma Prime is the Primed counterpart of the  Phantasma beam shotgun, sporting increased primary Critical Chance, Critical Multiplier, and beam range, and increased Ammo Maximum. Phantasma Prime was released alongside  Revenant Prime and  Tatsu Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Radiation damage.
Primary fire shoots six continuous beams.
Pinpoint accuracy.
Innate multishot of 6 beams.
Tied with  Phantasma,  Convectrix, and  Phage for the highest fire rate of all shotguns.
Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
Innate Infinite Body Punch Through.
Alternate Fire charges the weapon to fire a large plasma bomb that explodes in a 4.8 meter radius, which then releases 5 seeking projectiles.
The longer the charge is held down, the more damage is dealt by the explosion and its projectiles.
Plasma bomb and seeking projectiles have a guaranteed  Impact proc.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Advantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Very high overall status chance.
Tied with  Phantasma for the fastest reload speed of all primary shotguns.
No damage fall-off.
Highest base damage of all held-trigger primary weapons, tied with  Phantasma

Disadvantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Primary Fire:
Damage ramps up from 15% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 15% over 2 seconds.
Innate punch through does not apply to surfaces, requiring punch through mods.
Limited range of 25 meters.
Alternate Fire:
Projectile has travel time with heavy arcing.
Explosion inflicts self-stagger.
Explosion has a headshot multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
Explosion has linear Damage Falloff from 100% to 50% from central impact.
Low Ammo Pickup.

Acquisition

Notes
When wielded by  Revenant/ Revenant Prime, the Phantasma Prime's magazine size is increased by 4 rounds, for a total of 15 rounds.

Known Bugs
Alt firing then reloading immediately after will do a soundless Braton reload animation.
Ammo cost of charge increases as magazine depletes. For example, it may consume 2/2/2/3/3/4/6 ammo throughout a magazine.
Charged damage is reduced by -1 for each additional ammo consumed by the incremental auto-charge as magazine depletes.
 Galvanized Savvy is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from bomblets.
After a host migration, the magazine will lose its increased magazine by 4 rounds when wielded by  Revenant/ Revenant Prime.
